scenarios.name: Current sequence
scenarios.why: The current farm plan is the reference for comparison.
scenarios.evidence: Three seasons of field history are available.
scenarios.benefit: Known operating fit for this field.
scenarios.risk: Weather variability can shift planting windows.

scenarios.name: Soybean → Corn cover
scenarios.why: Alternating crop families maintains the current rotation pattern.
scenarios.evidence: SMAP soil moisture retrieval is available for the reference date.
scenarios.benefit: Familiar sequence with a cover-crop window.
scenarios.risk: A short dry spell may reduce emergence.

scenarios.name: Soybean → Cotton
scenarios.why: Introduces a fiber crop after soybean.
scenarios.evidence: Three seasons of crop history support a rotation comparison.
scenarios.gap: Buyer access and credit terms are unknown.
